ios.desc:
Zoro is the world’s first private wealth manager that puts you in total control. Most financial apps require you to sync your bank accounts to their servers, exposing your financial data to third parties. We do the opposite: Your data never leaves your phone.

Track your assets and expenses with quick but accurate data imports from password-protected PDFs and images. Set up reminders and use the helpers to stay up to date. Remember major investment decisions and holdings in each account. Plan for retirement and backtest your corpus against historical returns.

Upgrade to Zoro Pro for unlimited imports and exports and to customise all the helpers. We're just getting started, so expect plenty of updates soon!

Terms of use (EULA): https://www.getzoro.com/legal?tab=terms

quotes.text:
Your data stays on your phone. No bank sync track, no AI advice.

Just simple, better tracking but you are always in control. AI does the work you don’t want to do.

Built in fulter can do an Android version. Tried out Gemma on device models, doesn’t work too well. Solo founder open to a co-founder who can build and is passionate about this space.

Outcome of 8 months of taking to people about how they think about wealth retirement and reading lots of Reddit subs on money, FIRE and personal finance.
